subject: Hosted API discount & commit structure request — Clearsight.ai
messages:
From: Alex Reid <alex@clearsight.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>; Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Clearsight Procurement <procurement@clearsight.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request for hosted API pricing + commit tiers

Marcus / Vivek —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran a quick internal forecast and expect to ramp to ~120M tokens/month over Q1 with burst patterns around product launches. The team is evaluating a committed tier + per-token pricing approach but we have two constraints: predictable unit cost for finance (need a floor) and ability to ramp quickly without long procurement delays.

Attached is a short forecast and an initial SOW to kick off procurement review. High level asks:
- Can Redwood provide a committed slab for 100M tokens/month for Q1 with a blended per-token price under $0.0006?
- Is there a firm rate-card path vs. a custom exception process if we need steeper discounts tied to a 12-month commit?
- Any onboarding credits or migration support for model evaluation (we'll likely test RLHF and embeddings heavy workloads).

We'd like to finalize commercial terms by Nov 20 if possible. Happy to jump on a call.

Thanks,
Alex Reid
Head of Platform, Clearsight.ai

Attachments: Clearsight_Monthly_Usage_Forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet), CLEARSIGHT_SOW_v1.docx (word)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Reid <alex@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request for hosted API pricing + commit tiers

Alex —

Appreciate the detail and the forecast. Short answers to start: yes — we can structure a 100M/month commit and we have a documented rate card, but the blended price you ask for would likely require a 12-month commit + phased ramp and a commercial exception approval because it sits below our standard slab thresholds.

I'll loop in pricing and leadership for a quick approval path. Can you confirm whether the forecast accounts for embeddings-heavy traffic (embedding units billed differently) or is this all text-generation tokens? Also, are you planning to use Dedicated or Hosted API (hosted simplifies procurement but has different SLA/terms)?

Proposed next step: 30-min sync today or tomorrow to align on usage shape, then I will open an exception request and include a proposed mutual action plan.

Thanks — Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: Request for hosted API pricing + commit tiers

Grace / Naomi —

FYI — Clearsight is requesting a custom per-token blended price under $0.0006 on a 100M/mo commit. They are a product-led telco analytics prospect; likely to expand quickly if onboarding goes well. Marcus suggests this will require an exception since it falls under our discount guardrails.

Key ask from me: what is the quickest approval path (pricing committee vs. SDR-level concession)? They need terms by Nov 20. I also want to confirm whether we want to push them toward a Dedicated commitment (higher ARR, clearer commit mechanics) vs. hosted-per-token commit.

Attached forecast + SOW from the customer.

Vivek
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request for hosted API pricing + commit tiers

Vivek / team —

Thanks for the heads-up. Quick notes:
- If Clearsight is embeddings-heavy we need to separate embedding units from generation tokens in the SOW; blended math often hides a lot of margin pressure.
- For a blended price at $0.0006 we would want: 12-month commit, minimum 60% upfront payment, and a usage band that allows us to scale unit price after +50% overages.
- Exceptions: this is within the remit of the commercial committee (pricing@redwoodinference.com) because it materially impacts our per-token guidance. I can champion the thread but need a short justification (ARR potential, reference customers, technical risk).

Marcus — please add a quick ARR/TCV number and confirm if they are open to a Dedicated conversation. I'll submit to the committee this afternoon if we have the justification.

Grace
VP, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference

On Thu, Nov 12, 2026 at 10:22 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Grace / Naomi —

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request for hosted API pricing + commit tiers

Grace —

Clearsight confirmed via procurement they prefer Hosted API for faster onboarding. TCV looks like $1.8M ARR if they commit 100M/mo for 12 months (with some growth assumptions) — conservative model attached. They said embeddings account for ~35% of usage in month 1, rising to ~50% by month 6.

They are willing to do a 12-month commit with 60% upfront but asked for the $0.0006 blended target. I asked them to confirm flexibility on the overage band and whether they'd accept a tiered rate (e.g., $0.00065 base, $0.00055 for over 100M) instead of single blended.

I've created a short exception submission in HubSpot here: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345/DEAL-7890 — proposal doc attached locally. If the committee is okay with the tiered approach (and separating embeddings math), I think we can approve with standard exceptions (no legal redlines).

Next steps: Grace to submit to pricing committee; Naomi to confirm margin modeling; Vivek to propose go/no-go on Dedicated vs Hosted by EOD Monday.

Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Clearsight_Monthly_Usage_Forecast.xlsx, CLEARSIGHT_SOW_v1.docx
